v2.feedback: Strong concept-to-form translation — the calyx-as-patient-vessel receiving the bonk is genuinely witty and the damped harmonic recovery sells the comedy. The desaturate() guard and dual Turrell lighting are excellent craft choices. Two refinements: (1) ensure the bonk compression amplitude is large enough to read clearly at first glance (~30-40% height squash) without lingering — the comedy depends on a sharp attack envelope and slow dignified recovery, not a gentle sag; (2) the Lorenz-inspired drift in the vertex shader adds subtle turbulence but risks softening the petal silhouette over time — consider clamping drift magnitude more aggressively at petal edges so the 5-lobe form stays crisp between bonks, since the legibility of the 'before' state is what makes the deformation funny.
